page.overview:
Who is Division 2 Vice Captain?

The was a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a minor character during the Bomb Girl arc.

The Division 2 Vice Captain is an attractive man with pale brown hair that reaches the nape of his neck and dark eyes. The most notable features he has is a stud piercing near his lip and a charm on the handle of his katana.

As a high ranking Devil Hunter, he did not appear distressed by a sudden devil attack, approaching the scene with efficiency and calmness. He even makes casual conversation with his fellow Devil Hunters in between the attack. He was planning to attend a mixer continuing the incident, showing his confidence in his abilities.

He is familiar and respected by several Devil Hunters, such as Nomo.
